page.title: Loom woven placemat, set of 2, card form

product.name: Loom woven placemat, set of 2
product.description: You will find loom-woven cotton and not much else, packed Sunday evening as batch hemp bin fifty five.

blocks.text: A hemmer on the day shift likes it for a two-person table and wrote batch harbor loft eighty one on the slip.
Bring it out for a two-person table, packed in a paper band from the loom room, batch glass drawer twenty four.
A little cedar from the cupboard is the note on batch wool crock thirty seven, and shake crumbs off and wipe the mats with a damp cloth.
The crew at a wash house uses hand hemming for this, and this one is batch tin peg sixty eight.

presentation.review_line: Read the lines, then pay if they still fit.

trick.instruction: The shelf figure was twenty seven dollars and eighty nine cents and this page asks $34.22. Stop when the errand cap is under the higher figure.
